column1: # Galaxy Map Normandy strings, English. One line per string: id, a tab, the text (UTF-8). build.sh makes the mod's
# GlobalTlk packages from src/tlk/<language>.tsv; every language must have the same ids.

column2: Cluster: flight speed
How fast the ship flies at cluster level, with the controller and with the mouse. The map cursor, and so what is selected, moves at the same speed.
Cluster: turn rate
How fast the ship's nose turns toward where it flies at cluster level.
Cluster: ship response
How closely the ship follows the map cursor at cluster level. Lower values let it glide behind; higher values keep it on the cursor.
Cluster: ship size
Size of the ship at cluster level.
System: flight speed
How fast the ship flies in system view, with the controller and with the mouse. The camera follows the ship there, so the view moves faster too.
System: turn rate
How fast the ship's nose turns toward where it flies in system view.
System: ship response
How closely the ship follows the map cursor in system view. Lower values let it glide behind; higher values keep it on the cursor.
System: ship size
Size of the ship in system view.
Restore defaults
Sets every setting on this page back to its default.
Changes show the next time the map opens.
(default)
Current
Flight speed, turn rate, response and size of the ship on the galaxy map, at cluster level and in system view, and its flight sound. The same for every save.
Flight sound
The sound of the ship while it flies on the galaxy map. Picking one plays a short sample of it.
Original
The sound of earlier versions of this mod: Mass Effect 3's travel sound as it is, the same at both levels.
Mass Effect 3
Mass Effect 3's own mix: lower and muffled, with an engine note that rises with speed and a deeper drive in system view.
Mass Effect 2
Mass Effect 2's mix: the same as Mass Effect 3's, with a quieter engine and the short echo of its galaxy map.
Deep rumble
A lower, darker engine over a deep drive, with a longer echo.
Soft hum
Quiet and muffled: a faint whoosh and a low, steady hum.
Bright thrusters
A clearer, higher engine note that changes more with speed, and a wide drive.
